summary: UI list navigation input dispatch: scans an array of a4 short input codes at a3 until it finds code 203 (previous) or 205 (next) or exhausts the array. A code-205 hit increments the selection (either the int32 index at this+0xE0 in integer mode, or a mutable counter behind the vtable slot at offset 0xB4 in pointer mode), a code-203 hit decrements it, then signals the change via the vtable slot at offset 0x2C and returns 1; otherwise returns 0.

local_names.result: Return flag: 1 if a navigation code was processed, else 0
local_names.v5: Array index counter over the input code array a3
local_names.v7: Mutable counter pointer resolved from vtable slot 0xB4 (increment path)
local_names.v8: Mutable counter pointer resolved from vtable slot 0xB4 (decrement path)

operations.description: Initialize result to 0 and the array counter v5 to 0.
Guard on a4 (input code count) being greater than 0; when a4 is not positive, skip the scan and return result 0.
Iterate the short array at a3 by dword index v5; the loop exits when the current code equals 203, when a 205 branch jumps past it, or when v5 reaches a4.
Current short code at a3 + 2*v5 equal to 203 selects the decrement (previous) handling path.
Current short code at a3 + 2*v5 equal to 205 selects the increment (next) handling path.
The byte flag at this+0xF0 selects the storage mode: non-zero means pointer mode (mutate a counter object), zero means integer mode (mutate this[56]).
In pointer mode, resolve the mutable counter via the vtable slot at byte offset 0xB4 (this, a2); when it returns non-null, increment the pointed-to counter.
After mutating the counter in pointer mode, invoke the post-update callback at vtable slot 0xA4.
Set a2 to 1, invoke the change signal at vtable slot 0x2C, and set result to 1 to record that navigation occurred.
In integer mode, increment the selected index stored at this[56] (byte offset 0xE0).
In integer mode, run ShortComputation_8970 after the index change.

On code 203 (previous): in pointer mode decrement the counter resolved from vtable slot 0xB4 and invoke the 0xA4 callback; in integer mode decrement this[56] (byte offset 0xE0) and run ShortComputation_8970.
Return result: 1 if any navigation code was processed, otherwise 0.
